name: Superior Spring & Mfg. Co. Inc.
old_description: For the best experience on our site, be sure to turn on Javascript in your browser.
about:
Superior Spring & Mfg. Co. Inc. is based in Hamden, Connecticut. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates a service center that provides suspension and alignment work for trailers, tractors, and light-duty vehicles up to Class 8. Its shop uses a Bee-Line laser alignment system for front-end, rear, and tandem alignments, and a Hunter HD Elite wheel balancer for tire balancing. Technicians perform leaf-spring replacement and re-bushing, air-bag replacement, axle installation, frame-rail repair, wheelbase changes, air-suspension conversions, and custom fabrication of U-bolts and torque arms. The business also stocks and sells OEM-quality leaf springs, coil springs, and air-suspension kits from brands such as Cargomaxx, Pacbrake, and Rough Country.

Customers include individual vehicle owners and fleets across Connecticut, New York, Massachusetts, Vermont, and Rhode Island. The shop services major suspension brands including Hendrickson, Hutch, Reyco, Freuhauf, Trans Pro, Air Ride, and Neway, and is an authorized dealer for Flexiride and Rough Country products. Service calls cover everything from light-duty trailer repairs to heavy-duty tractor alignments and lift-kit installations.

Superior Spring emphasizes its use of advanced alignment technology and on-site custom fabrication to address non-standard repairs, such as pressing Mack trunnion shafts or building up leaf springs for higher weight ratings.

name: Supreme Solar & Electric Fresno
about:
Supreme Solar & Electric operates from Fresno, California, serving the Central Valley and Coachella Valley regions. The company was established by a team with over 12 years of combined experience in the solar industry and functions as a licensed solar and electrical contractor.

The firm designs, installs, and services residential solar energy systems, including rooftop and ground-mount arrays, solar patios, battery storage, and whole-home generators. It also provides panel cleaning, critter guards, system monitoring, and roofing services. To date, the company has completed more than 1,000 installations and backs its work with a 60-day installation guarantee and a 25-year warranty covering parts, labor, and system performance.

Supreme Solar & Electric focuses on homeowners in Fresno and the Coachella Valley, helping them navigate utility rate structures, permitting, and financing. Its customer base consists of residential clients seeking to reduce electricity costs and gain energy independence through solar-plus-storage solutions.

The company differentiates itself by handling every project in-house without subcontractors, assigning a dedicated project manager, and maintaining local support long after installation. Since California's net metering changes in 2023, it has specialized in paired solar and battery systems to maximize savings.

name: Surf-Tech Manufacturing Corporation
about:
Surf-Tech Manufacturing Corporation was founded in 1989 in Ronkonkoma, New York, in the technology and industry-rich heart of Suffolk County on Long Island. The company began as a contract manufacturer serving a broad range of industries and has remained at the same location, which offers quick access to component suppliers and transportation infrastructure, including proximity to Long Island MacArthur Airport.

The company provides full-service electronic manufacturing and assembly, specializing in surface mount technology (SMT), through-hole (TH) assembly, electro-mechanical box-build, and BGA assembly, rework, and replacement. It operates state-of-the-art automated placement equipment and supports both turnkey and consigned orders, with supply-chain connections that have enabled customers to shift to full turnkey arrangements. Services extend from prototype design to end-customer webstore fulfillment.

Surf-Tech serves customers across diverse industries, though the company does not publicly list specific sectors. Its client base includes organizations that require ITAR-registered manufacturing and IPC-certified workmanship, and the firm has maintained long-term relationships with many customers since its inception.

The company emphasizes quality and lean manufacturing, holding ISO 9001:2015 certification continuously since 2012 with zero third-party audit nonconformances. All inspectors maintain IPC-A-610 certification, and the facility uses a Cyberoptics 3D SQL automated inspection system for solder joint review and a VJ Electronicx X-ray machine for BGA and QFN inspection. Returns are reported at less than 0.01% annually, and functional testing is performed to customer-supplied fixtures and procedures.

Based in Anchorage, Alaska, Susitna Energy Solutions LLC operates as a distributor and installer of off-grid and renewable energy systems. The company serves customers across the state with a focus on off-grid living, remote camps, and renewable energy installations.

The company distributes products such as Ecoflow portable power stations, Dry-Flush sanitation systems, propane appliances, DC and solar-powered equipment, high-efficiency AC ranges and refrigerators, and alternative heating solutions. It provides sales, parts, service, and statewide installation for complete off-grid camp systems and remote camp solutions.

Susitna Energy Solutions serves residential customers pursuing off-grid lifestyles, as well as commercial and industrial clients operating remote camps in Alaska. Testimonials on the company's site reference installations in very remote locations and technical support for solar systems.

The company emphasizes its Alaskan roots and statewide service coverage, positioning itself as a local partner for energy independence. It highlights outstanding service and competitive pricing as key differentiators, and promotes awareness of federal renewable energy tax credits.

name: Susquehanna Valley Woodcrafters, Inc.
old_description: We pride ourselves on First Class customer service and quick turnaround on orders.
about:
Susquehanna Valley Woodcrafters, Inc. operates from Salunga in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 1998 by Jose Gonzalez, Rick Boyer, and Dave Gonzalez, who brought a combined 56 years of experience designing and running engineering and manufacturing systems, including 35 years focused on the kitchen, bath, and furniture component industry. The founders identified a market gap for reliable customer service and consistent on-time delivery of custom-sized drawers, which became the basis for the business.

The company specializes in manufacturing custom dovetail drawers, specialty custom drawers, and custom-size drawer box inserts. All products are built using environmentally friendly materials that meet green project requirements. A laser logo engraving service allows customers to add company or dealer logos to drawer boxes. Production follows strict manufacturing schedules designed to guarantee delivery dates, with the company committing to communicate upfront if a requested date cannot be met.

Susquehanna Valley Woodcrafters serves tradesmen, woodworkers, cabinetmakers, and cabinet manufacturers across the Northeastern, Southern, and Midwestern United States. Its customer base consists of industry professionals who outsource drawer box production to focus on their core cabinet installation and manufacturing operations.

The business was started because the founders believed the marketplace was starved for customer service. Their stated vision is to become the industry's most sought-after custom dovetail drawer manufacturer through a four-fold approach: manufacture high-quality custom drawers, deliver on time, build long-term relationships, and provide unmatched service. The company emphasizes that good service means reliably delivering high-quality drawers on time, as promised.

name: Switch Components, Inc. (SCI)
old_description: Push, toggle, rocker, ignition switches (HQ/engineering in CA; production overseas)
about:
Switch Components, Inc. (SCI) is headquartered in El Cajon, California. The company was established in 2018 as an independent component division of Triad Partners, LLC, after its switch products had been manufactured and sold through sister divisions OptiFuse and Vortex Technologies. The business is led by Jim Kalb.

SCI supplies AC and DC switch products including rocker, toggle, and pushbutton switches, battery disconnects, trailer connectors, USB charging ports, and relays. Production runs on automated lines featuring continuous table presses, robotic plastic injection and insertion molding, CNC machining, laser marking, and vision inspection. Manufacturing takes place at facilities in Tainan City, Taiwan, and Semarang, Indonesia.

The company serves the transportation, electrical, and electronic markets, with a focus on automotive, heavy-duty, marine, and recreational vehicle applications. Customers include OEMs and distributors seeking custom-made components for specific application needs.

SCI emphasizes its patented illuminated and non-illuminated switch designs, a Total Quality Management approach, and compliance with UL, SAE, ABYC ignition-protected standards, RoHS, REACH, conflict-mineral regulations, and California Proposition 65. The firm states that trust, transparency, and customer service form the basis of its relationships.

name: T & J Wire Forming Inc
old_description: Flat Forms, Wire Forms, Light Stampings & Fixtures, Powder Coating, Tooling & Dies
about:
T & J Wire Forming Inc. has operated from Addison, Illinois since its founding in 1991. The locally owned and operated shop began as a specialist in custom wire forming and has grown into a full-service metal fabrication partner.

The company produces wire forms, flat forms, light stampings, fixtures, and tooling and dies, working with both ferrous and non-ferrous materials. Its shop runs four-slide stamping presses for high-volume component production, CNC equipment for precision forming, and an in-house tool and die department that builds the dies used for cutting and swedging. Powder coating and plate finishing round out the service offering.

Its customer base consists mainly of other manufacturers and industrial firms across multiple sectors that need custom-formed wire and stamped components. The company emphasizes a personal-touch approach, tailoring production runs to client-specific requirements.

T & J Wire Forming highlights its ISO 9001:2015 certification, combined decades of manufacturing expertise, and a commitment to timely delivery of essential raw materials as the factors that distinguish its service.
